Hello.

Tea?

Just browsing!

La madame is the other way.

Arthur!

AHEM!

to--

Indeed there is.
Well? Where are they?

I-I need not bore you with the details.
Let's get straight down to business, shall we?
Good heavens!
Lady Unterwald's final moments were captured by the renowned speed painter, Pierre Brosse.

That means the attack must have been made from a distance.

That's right. I had to oversee some last minute amendments to the will.
Are you suggesting this amended will could reveal a motive, Mr Merman?

Bravo, Herman Merman! Bravo!

--moment!

Ma'am?

Bickering sycophants, the lot of them!

suck-ups!
